policy: Crosswalk is for retrieval, regression routing and coverage analysis only. It must not convert legacy Gold into V3 Gold without evidence re-verification against the Team Skill definition.

tool.fastapi.note: Framework use can retrieve software-development candidates but does not by itself prove the broad Team Skill.

tool.mysql.note: MySQL use is evidence relevant to database/data-management, not automatic proof of the broad node.

tool.redis.note: Redis cache use is context-dependent; it may support software implementation and sometimes data-management.

tool.docker.note: Docker use retrieves container/deployment candidates but does not prove orchestration or operations competence.

knowledge.restful_api.note: REST knowledge is related to software engineering but is not equivalent to demonstrated implementation ability.

knowledge.async_task.note: Async-task knowledge is implementation/system knowledge; requires behavior evidence for Team Skill support.

activity.api_implementation.note: Direct API implementation is a strong behavior cue for software engineering.

activity.data_storage.note: Relational storage behavior is directly relevant to database/data-management.

activity.task_status_polling.note: Polling behavior is a specific software implementation behavior.

activity.status_query.note: Status-query behavior is a specific software implementation behavior.

activity.log_recording.note: Logging may be an operations or software-engineering behavior depending on context.

activity.log_analysis.note: Log analysis is primarily relevant to operations/troubleshooting and may support quality evaluation.

activity.file_validation.note: File validation is a quality/validation behavior but can also be ordinary implementation.

activity.exception_handling.note: Exception handling is software implementation with possible quality implications.

activity.container_packaging.note: Container packaging is directly relevant to container platforms; deployment support depends on context.

activity.deployment_testing.note: Deployment testing touches both delivery/operations and system quality.

activity.data_validation.note: Data validation is a quality-control behavior and may relate to data management.

activity.retry_recovery.note: Retry/recovery is implementation reliability behavior; operations relevance depends on scope.

ability.backend_api_development.note: Specific backend API development is narrower than the broad software-engineering Team Skill.

ability.restful_api_development.note: RESTful API development is narrower than the broad software-engineering Team Skill.

ability.status_polling_interface_design.note: A specific interface-design capability under software engineering.

ability.task_status_polling.note: Specific implementation capability; broad Team Skill still requires direct evidence verification.

ability.async_task_design.note: Can be software or distributed-system design depending on implementation context.

ability.log_recording.note: Systematic logging is narrower than operations; context may instead indicate software implementation.

ability.log_analysis_troubleshooting.note: Troubleshooting via logs is a specific operations/quality capability.

ability.container_deployment_testing.note: Composite capability spans deployment, containers and testing; V3 must verify components separately.

ability.data_validation_fault_tolerance.note: Composite reliability capability; do not auto-collapse to one broad Team Skill.

ability.file_validation_exception_handli.note: Specific validation/fault-handling capability; broad support requires evidence re-check.

ability.mysql_data_storage.note: Specific MySQL storage capability is narrower than database/data-management.

ability.relational_database_operations.legacy_name: 关系型数据库读写与事务操作
ability.relational_database_operations.note: Relational DB operations are narrower than the broad database/data-management Team Skill.

ability.cache_application.note: Cache application is usually an implementation capability; data-management linkage is context-dependent.

ability.document_parsing_processing.note: Generic document parsing is software engineering; NLP only when semantic/language processing is actually evidenced.

ability.batch_script_development.note: Batch scripting is a specific software-development capability.

ability.permission_validation.note: Permission validation may support cybersecurity when security scope is explicit; otherwise ordinary software validation.

high_level.system_architecture_design.note: Strong architecture evidence maps naturally to software architecture/system design.

high_level.database_management.note: High-level database management maps naturally to data management/databases.

high_level.performance_optimization.note: No single Team Skill is an exact equivalent; performance optimization can span quality, implementation and operations.
